g.title: The containers
g.text: Container diagram · boring-mailstack · what runs, and how the pieces talk · as of v2026.10.14

g.title: cluster_mailstack
g.text: boring-mailstack · one host, Docker Compose · no MX of its own

g.title: imap
g.text: Retrieved mail stays at the provider

g.title: contacts
g.text: Contacts, calendar and files per user
Each user adds their own; no shared presets

g.title: getmail
g.text: Fetches by folder role; never deletes mail

g.title: webmail
g.text: Mail, Filters, Contacts, Calendar, cloud files
Reaches Stalwart only inside the stack

g.title: bridge
g.text: INBOX (Junk if listed): SMTP, the user's filter
Other folders: JMAP import, recorded as placed

g.title: store
g.text: Mailboxes, flags, full-text search and Sieve

g.title: provenance
g.text: Protects provider folders and human moves
Stable account + JMAP Email ID, not UID

g.title: resievewatch
g.text: Filter changed: existing mail sorted again
Moved into INBOX: back to the filter

g.title: legend
g.text: Frame · application ownership, not one network.
Postfix has a separate private relay path.
Arrowheads point from caller to service.
getmail polls the provider; mail returns to it.
Local edits never synchronize back upstream.
Stalwart reports IMAP moves, copies and appends
by webhook; moves into INBOX go to resieve-watch.
Retrieve, read or submit mail over TLS
Bridge chooses delivery or folder import
Stalwart submits to the Postfix relay
Prepare / init generate configuration and reconcile
provenance DB, relay spool and Roundcube DB.
Inbound delivery is at least once.
placements by hand and changes folders by JMAP.
Setup, browser ingress, other clients, ManageSieve
and the provider-Junk port (2525) are not drawn.
